# Zalven Calibration

> Zalven Calibration (also known as Zalven Calibration Shop) is a diesel fuel injection pump and
> injector calibration, testing, and repair shop in Caloocan City, Metro Manila, Philippines.

## About

Zalven Calibration specializes in testing, repairing, and calibrating diesel fuel injection pumps
and injectors for cars, trucks, and heavy equipment. Every pump is verified on a calibration test
bench before it leaves the shop, confirming correct fuel delivery, timing, and spray pattern.

## Services

- Fuel Pump Calibration — bench-tested calibration of inline and rotary diesel fuel injection pumps
- Injector Testing & Repair — nozzle cleaning, spray-pattern testing, injector overhaul
- Pump Overhaul & Rebuild — full teardown, inspection, and rebuild of mechanical fuel pump assemblies
- Common Rail Diagnostics — diagnostics and calibration for modern common-rail diesel injection systems
- Heavy Equipment Service — in-shop and on-site fuel system service for trucks, tractors, generators, and machinery
- Genuine Parts & Rebuild Kits — replacement using trusted-brand parts

## Engines Serviced

Isuzu, Mitsubishi, Toyota, Caterpillar, Perkins, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Stanadyne.

## Genuine Parts Brands

Bosch, Delphi, Zexel, OMS, Interstate-McBee.
